tools.name: Matchstick dice game
tools.purpose: Show that dependent steps with variation give less than average output and growing WIP.
outputs: cumulative output vs mean x rounds
tools.logic: Seeded RNG. Each round, for k in order: moved_k = min(roll_k, wip_k) (station 1 has unlimited input unless rope). wip_{k+1} += moved_k. Rope: station 1 input = moves of the slowest station last round.

tools.name: Herbie hike line
tools.purpose: Show line length (WIP) growth and fixes: Herbie first, lighter load, rope.
inputs: walkers with mean speed and spread
tools.logic: Each tick walker i moves min(own random step, gap to walker i-1 if rope) ; troop progress = last walker position.

tools.name: T, I, OE decision calculator
tools.purpose: Turn a decision into delta T, I, OE and the effect on NP, ROI, productivity.
tools.logic: T = sales - TVC; NP = T - OE; ROI = NP / I; accept if delta NP > 0 and delta ROI >= 0.

tools.name: Product mix by T per constraint minute
tools.purpose: Pick product mix by T per constraint minute; compare with margin-based choice.
inputs: resources: minutes per unit per product, capacity
tools.logic: Find resource with max load/capacity. Rank by (price - TVC)/minutes on it. Fill demand in rank order until capacity ends. Preset: P&Q example.

tools.name: Bottleneck finder
tools.purpose: Find bottleneck and CCRs from load versus capacity.
inputs: work orders with routing and hours
tools.logic: load = sum(hours needed)/available. Bottleneck = max load >= 100%. CCR = load >= 85%.

tools.name: Cost of a lost bottleneck hour
tools.purpose: Price lost constraint time in system throughput.
tools.logic: Value = T / constraint hours. Lost T = minutes / 60 x value. Sort causes.

tools.name: Batch size and lead time
tools.purpose: Show how process and transfer batch size change WIP and lead time.
inputs: steps with setup and unit time
outputs: setup share of time per step
tools.logic: Flow shop: each step starts after a transfer batch arrives; setup per process batch. Report lead time = completion - release.

tools.name: Drum-Buffer-Rope line
tools.purpose: Compare push release with DBR release on T, WIP and due-date performance.
tools.logic: Discrete time. Push: release at max rate. Rope: release when WIP ahead of constraint < buffer time x constraint rate.

tools.name: Buffer status board
tools.purpose: Color orders by buffer penetration and show cause Pareto.
tools.logic: penetration = (now - release)/(due - release) for open orders; green < 1/3, yellow < 2/3, red <= 1, black > 1.

tools.name: Five focusing steps checklist
tools.purpose: Walk a system through the five steps and catch inertia.
tools.logic: Fixed question list per step; step 5 lists every rule made for the old constraint.

tools.name: Evaporating cloud
tools.purpose: Build a five-box conflict cloud and list assumptions and injections.
tools.logic: Five nodes, five arrows (A<-B, A<-C, B<-D, C<-D', D x D'). Read-out: in order to A, we must B; in order to B we must D, because ...

tools.name: Thinking Process tree builder
tools.purpose: Build CRT, FRT, NBR, PRT and TT trees with AND groups.
tools.logic: Directed graph; AND group = edges sharing group id. Core problem = node with most downstream UDEs.

tools.name: CLR checklist
tools.purpose: Test each arrow of a tree against the eight reservations.
tools.logic: Fixed 8-category list; one prompt per category.

tools.name: Three questions worksheet
tools.purpose: Answer what to change, to what, and how, with links to trees.
tools.logic: Three sections; each links the right tree type.

tools.name: Jonah question deck
tools.purpose: Ask Jonah-style questions about a system instead of giving answers.
tools.logic: Fixed question sets keyed by concept id.

tools.name: Critical chain planner
tools.purpose: Build a critical chain with project and feeding buffers.
tools.logic: Cut durations; level resources; chain = longest resource-leveled path; project buffer = 50% of chain; feeding buffer = 50% of feeding path.

tools.name: Replenishment with dynamic buffer
tools.purpose: Compare forecast push with replenish-to-consumption and DBM.
tools.logic: Each day order what was sold. DBM: if in red (< 1/3 target) for a lead time, target x 4/3; if green (> 2/3) for 3 lead times, target x 2/3.

tools.name: Little's Law calculator
tools.purpose: Solve WIP = throughput x lead time for any one value.
inputs: two of WIP, throughput, lead time
tools.logic: L = lambda W.

tools.name: Kingman queue calculator
tools.purpose: Show queue time versus utilization and variability.

tools.name: Cost of delay / WSJF ranker
tools.purpose: Rank work by cost of delay per unit of constraint time.
inputs: items: cost of delay per week, duration
tools.logic: WSJF = CoD / duration; sort descending.

tools.name: Kanban board with WIP limits
tools.purpose: Visual pull board with WIP limits per column.
tools.logic: Pull allowed only if column count < limit.

tools.name: Flow metrics: CFD, cycle-time scatter, item age
tools.purpose: Show WIP, cycle time and aging work from item start and finish dates.
inputs: items: start date, finish date, state history
tools.logic: CFD: count entered per state per day; WIP = vertical gap; approx cycle time = horizontal gap. Percentiles over finished items.

tools.name: Monte Carlo delivery forecast
tools.purpose: Forecast when N items finish from past daily throughput.
tools.logic: Seeded: each run samples past days with replacement until items left = 0; report percentiles of days.

tools.name: Critical WIP and best/worst case
tools.purpose: Compare a line's cycle time to best, worst and practical worst case.
tools.logic: W0 = rb T0. Best TH = min(w/T0, rb); worst TH = 1/T0; PWC TH = w/(W0 + w - 1) rb.

tools.name: Process behavior chart (XmR)
tools.purpose: Separate signal from noise before you react to a number.
tools.logic: Limits = mean +/- 2.66 x mean moving range; signal if a point is outside limits.

tools.name: Value stream map
tools.purpose: Map steps, queues and times; find where lead time goes.
tools.logic: VA ratio = sum process time / lead time; takt = available time / demand.

tools.name: Causal loop and archetype template
tools.purpose: Draw reinforcing and balancing loops; match a system archetype.
tools.logic: Loop sign = product of link signs; even number of minus = reinforcing.
